note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目，術語表沒有獨立的條目；只在 IFRS 對照的版面啟用，教材版面下停用。
note.en: An extension account added by the site; the glossary has no separate entry. It is enabled only in the IFRS comparison layout and disabled under the course layout.

definition.zh-TW: 把設立費在付出當期就全部列為費用時所用的科目。IFRS 對照的損益表把它列在營業費用。
definition.en: The account used when start-up costs are expensed in full in the period they are paid. The IFRS comparison income statement shows it under operating expenses.
